# Quicx

> Quicx is a lightweight, deterministic task queue engine with a custom PMAD slab allocator and a fast binary protocol. Configure it once. Run it forever.

Quicx runs a single-threaded event loop (epoll/kqueue) on top of a custom PMAD slab allocator for deterministic, zero-fragmentation memory, and a custom binary protocol (6-byte header, push/pop/ack/err). Written in C, with a Java client library (QuicxClient, QuicxWorker).

## Docs
- [Documentation](https://quicx.dev/docs): Full docs — architecture, configuration, CLI reference, Java client
- [Installer](https://quicx.dev/install.sh): One-line install script
